Educational channel for veterinary students and veterinary surgeons, which is created 2007 and it contains videos showing some surgical affections of animals and their treatments under field condition with limited facilities
(۞ Veterinary surgery ۞ Veteriner Cerrahi ۞ Veterinaire Chirurgie ۞ Cirugía Veterinaria ۞ Chirurgie vétérinaire ۞ Rectum veterinarii ۞ Chirurgia veterinaria ۞ Chirurgia Weterynaryjna ۞۞ Kirurgjia Veterinare  ۞ الجراحة البيطرية ۞  جراحی دامپزشکی ۞ ویٹرنری سرجری पशु चिकित्सा सर्जरी ۞ 獣医の手術 ۞ )
Surgery, anesthesiology and radiology Dept (Faculty of veterinary medicine) ۞ Minia & Sohag Universities ۞ Egypt
Emails: mmm_bbb15@yahoo.com  ۞  mohamedahh2008@yahoo.com
